intendedObjective: Update the invoice count, balance, and oldest invoice date from the completed reconciliation.
acceptableEditScope: Change only those three facts; retain account status and payment instructions.
stableFactsAndClaims: Review the attached statement and contact accounts if a payment appears missing.
Bank transfers use invoice references; combined transfers include every invoice number.
The account remains open; the notice requests reconciliation and is not a suspension notice.
A separate confirmation follows the records check.
Previously sent payments should be reported with transfer date and covered invoice numbers; do not send full bank statements or login details.
voiceConstraints: Measured administrative tone; preserve the distinction from suspension.
